policy: AI-generated live-action style demos. Prompts describe the movement only; no load, angle, rep or percentage values from the unverified draft. Every clip is labelled 'AI 生成示範 · 非真人拍攝' and is pending coach approval.
style: Photorealistic live-action footage, premium sports documentary look, natural light, steady camera, single adult athlete in plain dark outdoor clothing with no logos, no on-screen text, no watermark, realistic anatomy, 16:9.

clips.s_01_02: Indoor gym. An adult athlete stands side-on to a cable machine anchored at chest height, in an athletic half-squat like a snowboard stance, slowly presses the handle straight out from the chest and resists the sideways pull with a still torso, then pivots and throws a medicine ball explosively against a padded wall with a hip-driven rotation. Side and three-quarter angles.
clips.s_01_03: Indoor studio. Barefoot adult faces a wall in a half-kneeling lunge and drives the front knee forward toward the wall while the heel stays down, then stands on one leg on a soft balance pad keeping steady balance with arms relaxed. Close-up of ankle and knee, then full body.
clips.s_01_04: Snowy ski resort base area in the morning. An adult snowboarder in boots, board leaning on a rack, does a light dynamic warm-up: marching high knees, jumping jacks, walking lunges with torso rotation, leg swings, then light squat jumps. Upbeat but calm documentary framing.
clips.s_02_01: Groomed ski run with scattered skiers and snowboarders. A snowboarder rides behind slower people, keeps a wide berth, looks uphill over the shoulder before merging, and stops at the side of the run where they are visible from above, never in the middle below a roll-over. Wide drone and follow shots.
clips.s_02_02: Ski workshop bench. Hands measure a snowboard stance width with a tape measure, adjust bindings with a screwdriver on the disc, center the boot on the board so toe and heel overhang are even, and set the highback. Then the rider steps in and flexes into a stance. Macro and medium shots.
clips.s_02_03: Flat snow area near a chairlift. A snowboarder with only the front foot strapped in pushes with the back foot like a skateboard, glides with the free foot resting on the board by the rear binding, then loads a chairlift and exits it smoothly gliding away down the ramp. Follow camera.
clips.s_02_04: Ski shop with a wall of snowboards. A rider compares several boards by standing them upright next to the body, flexes the boards by hand to feel stiffness, and looks at a weight chart sticker on the topsheet. Calm retail lighting, close-ups of hands and board flex.
clips.s_03_01: Gentle beginner slope. A snowboarder strapped in hops lightly in place, lands softly and settles into a relaxed centered stance with ankles, knees and hips gently flexed, arms relaxed and quiet, head level, then glides straight in that stance. Side profile and front angle.
clips.s_03_02: Intermediate slope. A snowboarder sideslips on the toe edge by pressing shins into the boot tongues with hips forward, then sideslips on the heel edge sitting slightly into the heels with a tall upper body, alternating smoothly. Close-up of boots and edges, then full body.
clips.s_03_03: Gentle slope. A snowboarder demonstrates twisting the board between the feet: the front foot tips toward the toes while the back foot stays on the heel edge, steering the nose down the hill into a smooth turn. Close-up of feet and board flex, then follow shot.
clips.s_03_04: Groomed blue run. A snowboarder carves a turn leaning the whole body into the turn in a straight line, then the next turn bends at the hips and knees keeping the upper body more upright over the board. Contrasting two body shapes, side and rear follow camera.
clips.s_04_01: Beginner slope. A snowboarder sideslips straight down on the heel edge controlling speed, then drifts left and right across the slope in a falling-leaf pendulum pattern, then repeats facing uphill on the toe edge. Slow controlled movement, wide and medium shots.
clips.s_04_02: Gentle slope. A snowboarder traverses, lets the nose drift toward the fall line, then edges back to traverse in a garland shape, then links full turns from heel edge to toe edge into smooth S-turns. Drone overhead showing the track, then follow camera.
clips.s_04_03: Red run. A snowboarder rides skidded parallel turns with a quiet upper body and hands calmly at waist height, steering with the legs, alternating short and medium turn sizes. Front and rear follow camera.
clips.s_04_04: Groomed run. A snowboarder links gripped parallel turns, moving the hips slightly forward at the start of each turn and centered through the end, smooth fore-aft flow, clean snow spray. Side tracking shot.
clips.s_05_01: Wide empty groomed slope. A snowboarder rolls the board onto its edge without twisting it and lets it carve a clean J-shaped arc, leaving a thin pencil-line track in the corduroy. Low angle close-up of the edge track, then drone overhead of the line.
clips.s_05_02: Groomed steep run on a sunny day. An expert snowboarder carves dynamically, retracting the legs under the body at the edge change and extending them to push the board away through the turn, smooth rhythmic carving. Side tracking and slow-motion shots.
clips.s_05_03: High-speed groomed run. An expert snowboarder holds a strong heel-side carve with hips facing the nose, upper body countered and stacked over the board, not leaning inside, deep clean carve. Rear follow and low side angle.
clips.s_05_04: Wide perfect corduroy groomer, empty slope. An expert snowboarder performs Euro-carve style deep carves, body low with a hand gently touching the snow inside the turn, smooth flowing arcs. Drone and low-angle slow motion.
clips.s_06_01: Flat snow area. A snowboarder shifts the hips over the tail and lifts the nose into a tail press, balances, then moves over the nose into a nose press with the tail lifted, holding balance. Side profile, playful freestyle vibe.
clips.s_06_02: Gentle slope. A snowboarder rides, loads the tail by shifting weight back, and springs into an ollie, then loads the nose and pops a nollie, landing softly with knees bent. Side profile with slow-motion pop.
clips.s_06_03: Mellow groomed slope, Japanese ground trick style. A snowboarder rides a heel-side carve, then flows into a smooth ground spin on the snow ending in a nose press rotation, fluid and stylish. Follow and wide shots.
clips.s_06_04: Mellow groomed slope, Japanese ground trick style. An advanced snowboarder presses the tail on the heel edge, pre-winds the upper body and rebounds off the tail into a frontside spin, landing locked on the edge. Slow-motion side angle.
clips.s_07_01: Terrain park. A snowboarder first rides past a small jump to inspect it, then hits it with a straight air and grabs the toe edge between the bindings, landing clean on the landing slope. Wide shot and slow motion.
clips.s_07_02: Terrain park medium jump. A snowboarder makes a set-up carve before the takeoff, pops and rotates a smooth frontside 180 then on another run a 360, landing clean. Side and follow angles with slow motion.
clips.s_07_03: Terrain park. A snowboarder rides straight onto a wide box with a flat base and slides 50-50 across it, then on the next pass slides a boardslide sideways on the box, eyes on the end of the feature. Side angle.
clips.s_07_04: Large terrain park jump on a bluebird day. An expert snowboarder performs an off-axis cork spin, tilted rotation, landing clean. Professional slow-motion side and follow shots.
clips.s_08_01: Mogul field. A snowboarder rides through bumps, absorbing each mogul by pulling the knees up and extending into the troughs, head staying level. Front-facing follow camera.
clips.s_08_02: Steep black run with firm snow. An expert snowboarder makes controlled hop turns and quick edge checks to manage speed, compact and balanced. Wide shot from below and side angle.
clips.s_08_03: Spaced glade of snowy trees with soft snow. A snowboarder rides slowly between the trees looking at the open gaps, making short turns, controlled speed. Follow camera from behind.
clips.s_08_04: Mixed spring conditions on a slope. A snowboarder rides firm icy snow with gentle smooth edging, then slushy soft spring snow with a centered relaxed stance. Montage of conditions, side and follow shots.
clips.s_09_01: Deep fresh powder on an open slope in a resort. A snowboarder on a directional powder board surfs smooth flowing turns, rising and sinking rhythmically, spraying powder. Drone and side slow-motion shots.
clips.s_09_02: Backcountry trailhead. A small group of ski-touring snowboarders review an avalanche forecast on a phone and a map, point at slope aspects, and discuss the route calmly. Documentary style, no danger depicted.
clips.s_09_03: Snowy backcountry training area. A group performs an avalanche rescue drill: one person walks with an avalanche transceiver searching, then probes the snow, and teammates dig in an organized shoveling line. Calm practice drill.
clips.s_09_04: Training scene with a professional guide on a gentle snowy slope in a ski area, explaining tree-well awareness and pointing at a deep hole around a snowy spruce from a safe distance, riders keeping well away. Educational, no person in danger.
clips.s_10_01: Gentle slope with soft snow, controlled practice. A snowboarder practices a safe fall: arms tucked to the chest, chin tucked, rolling onto the back and shoulders instead of reaching out with hands. Slow motion, soft landing.
clips.s_10_02: Workbench in a ski workshop. Hands hold a snowboard in a vise, smooth the edge with a gummy stone and a diamond file using a side edge guide. Macro close-ups of the tools and edge.
clips.s_10_03: Workbench in a ski workshop. Hands brush the base, drip warm wax with a waxing iron, iron it smoothly, scrape it with a plastic scraper and finish with a brush. Macro shots, warm workshop light.
clips.s_10_04: Montage on a sunny resort: a snowboarder progresses from gentle turns on a green run, to confident carving on a blue run, to small park jumps and powder riding. Inspirational documentary tone.
clips.atomic_01: Mellow slope. A snowboarder demonstrates an ollie: weight shifts back to load the tail, springs off the tail, levels the board in the air and lands centered. Side profile slow motion.
clips.atomic_02: Mellow slope. A snowboarder demonstrates a nollie: weight moves forward to load the nose, springs off the nose and lands centered. Side profile slow motion.
clips.atomic_03: Flat groomed snow. A snowboarder holds a nose press: hips over the front binding, front knee bent, tail lifted off the snow, balanced glide. Side profile.
clips.atomic_04: Flat groomed snow. A snowboarder holds a tail press: hips over the back binding, nose lifted off the snow, balanced glide. Side profile.
clips.atomic_05: Mellow slope. A snowboarder on the heel edge winds the upper body the opposite way before a frontside spin, showing the twist between shoulders and hips, then unwinds into the spin. Front angle.
clips.atomic_06: Mellow slope. A snowboarder on the toe edge pre-winds the shoulders before a backside spin, then rotates blind and spots the landing over the shoulder. Front and rear angles.
clips.atomic_07: Mellow slope. A snowboarder slides the board around on the snow in a reverting spin and catches the new uphill edge firmly to stop the rotation. Close-up of board and edges, then full body.
clips.atomic_08: Mellow slope. A snowboarder pops a small jump and twists the board under the body while the upper body stays facing forward, a shifty, then unwinds before landing. Slow motion side and front angles.
